aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it misses the actual STD vs R LINE vs L LINE comparison and misgroups measurements.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not the compared sample conditions.
Baseline/test conditions are marked unclear despite source rows naming STD, R LINE, and L LINE.
Key graph summary rows for STD/R/L averages are not used as primary evidence.
Specs and summary values appear mixed into measurement statistics.
RAW DATA numeric columns are mislabeled as conditions and overgrouped.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to sample line comparison: STD baseline vs R LINE and L LINE.
Cite RAW DATA sample-name rows and GRAPH summary rows for condition evidence.
Group outcomes by SPL bands, Fo, and THD frequencies from GRAPH headers/spec rows.
Recompute stats excluding spec limits and non-measurement header values.
Use RAW DATA only for detailed per-frequency support after header alignment.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient and not tied to the true comparison conditions.
